prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone mirror selfie of an adult fantasy elf cosplayer sitting on a soft white sheet on a gray carpet in a minimal beige room. Keep the composition intimate but non-explicit, with realistic skin texture, fabric folds, carpet detail, and no added text or watermark.
